title: Plate Filling Heat Inactivated Covid Samples for PCR - Part 3
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Fill plates with saline
steps.instruction: Prepare each 96‑well deep‑well plate with 600 µL of saline in every well. Load the plates starting at slot 4. Using the left and right multi‑channel pipettes, aspirate saline and dispense it two columns at a time until all wells of the specified number of plates contain 600 µL.

substeps.instruction: Load the required number of 96 deep‑well plates into slots beginning with slot 4.
Using the left and right multi‑channel pipettes, aspirate 600 µL of saline and dispense into two columns of wells at a time, filling every well of each plate.
